title: Aadhaar App
section: An Aadhaar Verifiable Credential is a digitally signed document issued by the Authority to the Aadhaar Number Holder. It may contain the last 4 digits of the Aadhaar number, demographic data such as name, address, gender, date of birth, and photograph of the Aadhaar Number Holder, and such other information as may be specified by the Authority. These credentials may be shared by the Aadhaar Number Holder, in full or in part, with an OVSE in the manner specified by the Authority, for verifying the demographic information or the photograph of the Aadhaar Number Holder. Yes. An Aadhaar Number Holder (ANH) can share Aadhaar Verifiable Credentials in full or in part. The shared credentials may include a combination of demographic details, including the photograph, based on the user’s consent. Can the Aadhaar App be used to access and share the user’s current location? No, the Aadhaar app does not capture the location. How does the app give me control over my data? The app places control over data sharing directly in the hands of the Aadhaar Number Holder. The ANH can choose to share Aadhaar data either full or in part, with whom, and for what purpose. Which features of the Aadhaar app enable secure and private use of data? The app includes face authentication-based onboarding, consent-based selective data sharing, and biometric lock features that protect identity and ensure that only Aadhaar Number Holders (ANH) can access their Aadhaar information. Who should use the Aadhaar App? Any Aadhaar Number Holder who seeks a secure, convenient, and privacy-centric way to verify identity, share Aadhaar information, and manage personal identity data can use the Aadhaar App. Can the Aadhaar app be used when the developer option is enabled? No. The Aadhaar app cannot be used when developer mode is enabled. This restriction is implemented to ensure data security and user protection. How can the Aadhaar Verifiable Credential file be read? Aadhaar Verifiable Credentials are machine-readable files that can be shared via WhatsApp or email. They can be read using UIDAI-issued tools and prescribed technical standards. How is consent management handled in the Aadhaar app? Consent management in the Aadhaar app is governed by the Aadhaar Act and other applicable laws. No identity data is shared without the explicit consent of the Aadhaar Number Holder. If data is updated by an Aadhaar Number Holder(ANH), how soon is it reflected in the Aadhaar App?
